description: This Java class, MongoQueryBuilderFactory, implements the QueryBuilderFactory interface to create QueryBuilder instances for MongoDB, applying limits and criteria checks as part of the query construction process.

classes.name: MongoQueryBuilderFactory
classes.description: A final immutable class that creates QueryBuilder instances for MongoDB with specified search limits based on criteria.

methods.name: MongoQueryBuilderFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the limits configuration for query building.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new limited QueryBuilder based on criteria with max and default page size limits.

methods.name: newUnlimitedBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new QueryBuilder without limits based on criteria.

methods.name: checkCriteria
methods.description: Private static method that asserts criteria is not null.
